dt: Expressions of interest to the group by Oct 25, 2026; the national Juan de la Cierva call closes Nov 26 and Ramón y Cajal Dec 11, 2026
e: The UIB gravity group invites expressions of interest from candidates it could support for competitive fellowships (junior and senior postdoc, and Ramón y Cajal tenure-track). Topics include gravitational-wave data analysis, waveform modelling and numerical relativity, with interest in IGWN, LISA and Einstein Telescope work.
f: University of the Balearic Islands (UIB), GRAVITY group
n: UIB Palma: Fellowship and tenure-track opportunities in gravitational-wave physics
unv: Eligibility and salary depend on each fellowship call; the regional Margalida Comas and Vicenç Mut calls had not opened yet.
